entry.title: Clementine-XT 0.9.7
entry.summary: - **ROM check in the installer app.** The plugin declares its files, so the installer app's **Your ROMs and files** step checks each one before copying it into `ROMS`: the 256 KB Microwave II image or its two 128 KB chip images, and Waldorf `.syx` sound banks. - No change to the sound or the skin. Downloads: `Clementine-XT-0.9.7-mpc-armv7.zip` for Gen1 MPC and Force, `Clementine-XT-0.9.7-mpc-aarch64.zip` for Gen2 (MPC OS 3.x). Your files in `ROMS` are kept on upgrade.

entry.title: Clementine-XT 0.9.6
entry.summary: Rebuilt against the updated mpc-vst-plugins wrapper: **Q-Links now move parameters on track edit → automation** (a plain host write no longer makes MPC rebuild its parameter screen; sd88me/mpc-vst-plugins#486). No other changes. `*-mpc-armv7.zip` is for Gen1 MPCs and the Force; `*-mpc-aarch64.zip` is the Gen2 build (MPC OS 3.x), tested offline only. Settings and your own files in the plugin's data folders are kept on upgrade.

entry.title: Clementine-XT 0.9.5

entry.title: Clementine-XT 0.9.4
entry.summary: Clementine-XT 0.9.4: with your ROM in the plugin's `ROMS/` folder, the plugin now also reads the 256 factory sounds out of it and offers them as the bank **XT Factory** (the first bank on the SOUNDS tab). You no longer need a separate factory `.syx`. Nothing from Waldorf is shipped; the sounds are decoded on the device from the ROM you supply. entry.title: Clementine-XT 0.9.3
entry.summary: Clementine-XT 0.9.3: the skin is now written in the shape MPC OS 2.x reads, and the library needs glibc 2.29 or less, so the catalog labels this release "MPC OS 2.x + 3.x". The sound and parameters are unchanged. **Not yet tried on a 2.x unit**; it was tested on a Force (MPC OS 5.0.17) only. Feedback from MPC OS 2.x users is welcome.
